title: 电容的串并联与电压分配
statement: 图中 C1 = 2 µF，C2 = 1 µF，C3 = 3 µF，三个电容原来都不带电。从 t = 0 起，电流源以恒定电流 Is = 2 mA 给这组电容充电。
求 a、地之间的等效电容 C_eq，以及 t = 10 ms 时的 u_a、u_C1 和 u_C2。

questions.ask: a、地之间的等效电容 C_eq = ?
questions.explain: C2 ∥ C3 = 1 + 3 = 4 µF（并联相加）；再与 C1 串联：C_eq = 2 × 4/(2 + 4) = 4/3 µF ≈ 1.333 µF（串联按“积除以和”）。
送入的电荷 q = Is·t = 2×10⁻³ × 0.01 = 20 µC，u_a = q/C_eq = 20 µC / (4/3 µF) = 15 V。
C1 中流过的就是全部电流，q1 = 20 µC，u_C1 = q1/C1 = 20/2 = 10 V。
C2、C3 并联，共同得到 20 µC：u_C2 = 20 µC / 4 µF = 5 V。验算：u_C1 + u_C2 = 15 V = u_a ✓。

hints: 电容并联：C = C2 + C3（像电阻串联那样相加）；电容串联：1/C = 1/C1 + 1/C'（像电阻并联）。
恒流充电时送入的电荷 q = Is·t。原来不带电的串联电容电荷相等，所以电压按电容的倒数分配。
solution: **2. 电荷。** 恒定电流 2 mA 流过 C1 和 C23，10 ms 内送入 q = Is·t = **20 µC**。结点 m 原来不带电，C1 下极板流出的电荷全部到了 C2、C3 的上极板：q1 = q2 + q3 = 20 µC。
**4. 验算。** u_a = q/C_eq = 20/(4/3) = 15 V ✓。串联电容中，电容小的分到的电压大（C1 = 2 µF 得 10 V，C23 = 4 µF 得 5 V）。

en.title: Capacitors in series and parallel, voltage sharing
statement: C1 = 2 µF, C2 = 1 µF, C3 = 3 µF, all initially uncharged. From t = 0 on, a current source charges the group with a constant current Is = 2 mA.
Find the equivalent capacitance C_eq between a and ground, and u_a, u_C1 and u_C2 at t = 10 ms.

questions.ask: Equivalent capacitance between a and ground, C_eq = ?
questions.explain: C2 ∥ C3 = 1 + 3 = 4 µF (parallel capacitors add); in series with C1: C_eq = 2 × 4/(2 + 4) = 4/3 µF ≈ 1.333 µF (series capacitors combine as product over sum).
The charge delivered is q = Is·t = 2×10⁻³ × 0.01 = 20 µC, so u_a = q/C_eq = 20 µC / (4/3 µF) = 15 V.
The whole current flows through C1, so q1 = 20 µC and u_C1 = q1/C1 = 20/2 = 10 V.
C2 and C3 are in parallel and together receive 20 µC: u_C2 = 20 µC / 4 µF = 5 V. Check: u_C1 + u_C2 = 15 V = u_a ✓.

hints: Capacitors in parallel add: C = C2 + C3 (like resistors in series); in series: 1/C = 1/C1 + 1/C' (like resistors in parallel).
With a constant charging current the delivered charge is q = Is·t. Initially uncharged series capacitors carry equal charge, so the voltage divides in inverse proportion to capacitance.
solution: **1. Equivalent capacitance.** C2 ∥ C3: C23 = 1 + 3 = 4 µF. C1 in series with C23: C_eq = C1·C23/(C1 + C23) = 8/6 = **4/3 µF**.

**2. Charge.** The constant 2 mA flows through C1 and C23; in 10 ms it delivers q = Is·t = **20 µC**. Node m was uncharged, so all the charge leaving C1's lower plate ends up on the upper plates of C2 and C3: q1 = q2 + q3 = 20 µC.
**3. Voltages.** u_C1 = q/C1 = **10 V**; u_C2 = u_C3 = q/C23 = **5 V** (q2 = 5 µC, q3 = 15 µC, shared in proportion to capacitance); u_a = u_C1 + u_C2 = **15 V**.
**4. Check.** u_a = q/C_eq = 20/(4/3) = 15 V ✓. In a series string the smaller capacitor takes the larger voltage (C1 = 2 µF gets 10 V, C23 = 4 µF gets 5 V).
